crossRefs.note: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.
translations.bsb: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
translations.kjv: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew
translations.asv: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
